display_title: Did Someone Forced You to Be the Heavenly Demon?
description:
Seo Ji-Hun, a 9th-grade civil servant, longed for a long, peaceful life. However, he was stabbed to death by a malicious complainant, and opened his eyes in the martial arts world where martial arts existed. He longed for a quiet life there, but an unavoidable figure appeared before him.

 *"Choose. Death here, or becoming my disciple."*

The old man, who suddenly thrust a knife into his throat, was the leader of the Cheonma Sect. Believing that survival was the only way to achieve success, Seo Ji-Hun, reluctantly, decided to become a Cheonma. Originally a capable civil servant, he grew into a unique talent within the cult with his powerful martial arts skills and exceptional wisdom—but why does his workload keep piling up? Why does he keep getting promoted? His original goal was simply a "peaceful life," but somehow, his second life spiraled into the path of the Cheonma. Will he ever find the life he truly desires in this world?

(Source: Naver, translated)
